Intel Shares Surge After Revenue Shatters Estimates
videos.description: Intel Corp. surged in late trading after the chipmaker’s revenue forecast shattered estimates, indicating that booming data center spending is helping fuel a long-awaited turnaround. Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow spoke to CEO Lip-Bu Tan who said demand is outpacing the current supply. Ed recaps his conversation and has more on "Bloomberg The Close." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: US Retail Strength Is Bad News for Inflation Fight | Presented by CME Group
videos.description: After four years of stubborn, above-trend inflation, June delivered two pivotal economic signals: the largest monthly decline in inflation since April 2020 and the fifth straight month of increase in retail sales. Why is continued consumer strength likely to complicate the pace of disinflation?
